rationale: No existing spec drives the SQL-tab Simple/Multi toggle, the value-column dropdown, or the SQL-multi payload-pinning save path. alerts-multialert-ui.spec.js covers the *grouped* multi-alert surfaces (function=avg + group_by) and seeds them via the API, never touching the SQL condition block. alerts-scheduled-features.spec.js drives SQL mode but only for simple count SQL (preview/would-trigger), never Multi. The SQL Multi Alert feature is its own Alerts sub-area (SQL condition block multi mode) with distinct selectors (alert-sql-agg-*, alerts-alertmultitoggle-choice). Create a new spec at the run-context spec_path and register it in the Alerts shard run_files (tests/ui-testing/ci-matrix/ci_matrix.json, not playwright.yml — the matrix is the registration source of truth per .github/workflows/playwright.yml).
